# dream.vaked.dev

Milarepa útja — a gyakorlat hangja és képe. A techno-zen-buddhism ternary-quant site.

## What this is

A self-generating, client-side-only meditation surface: OM·AH·HUM mantras, the book read aloud, random pujas, the 17 Karmapa lineage chorus, and Milarepa's journey visuals (ego → ego-death → inner silence → the nine sins → realization → awakening → emptiness → enlightenment). Seven languages: magyar, latin, ómagyar, tibeti, kínai, maja, angol.

## Technical

- 100% client-side, zero backend, zero dependencies.
- WebAssembly (WAT) ternary-quant core: BitNet b1.58 {-1,0,+1} weights drive the particle field.
- WebGPU renderer when available, WebGL2/Canvas2D fallback.
- WebWorker for the particle simulation.
- Web Audio: formant-synthesis chanting, convolver reverb, live synthesis (no samples).

## Files

- `index.html` — the full experience (single file)
- `wasm/ternary.wasm` — the ternary-quant core
- `wasm/ternary.wat` — the WAT source
- `wasm/quantntp.wasm` — the quantNTP time-sync core (the breath clock)
- `AGENTS.md` — MILAREPA agent/skill definition
- `llms.txt` — this file
- `robots.txt` — anti-AI-scraper
- `_headers` — CSP + noai
- `.well-known/` — security + metadata

## quantNTP

The breath cycle (4s in, 4s out) is anchored to the synced clock: the breath phase derives from the NTP-corrected time, not the local frame. A browser NTP client (timeapi.io) measures the network offset, median-filters it, and quantizes it into balanced ternary {-1,0,+1} trits via WASM — the stratum of the now (0 = exact, 1 = near, 2 = drifting, 3 = far).

## The teaching

Az álom a valóság vetülete; a felismerés a fény; aki felismeri, nem a tükröt keresi — a fényt. (The dream is the projection of reality; the recognition is the light; whoever recognizes does not seek the mirror — the light.)

*the constellation · 0 + 1 · fine touch from within · vaked.dev*
